exact_statement: For every uniform Boolean cube, a spectral probability law supported on at most four labels is realizable iff it is a singleton of mass1 or the uniform law on an affine plane. A uniform affine-subspace law of dimension r is realizable iff r is even, and then H=r<=2D<=2I. For arbitrary supported laws, phase realizability is equivalent to phase realizability on the support affine-span quotient. The labelled four-variable law with Walsh magnitudes (8,8,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,0,0,0,0,0,0) and denominator256 passes all15 separate XOR pair partitions but has no realizing phase (all512 phases certified). Complete exact enumeration on n=4 yields2261 distinct Boolean spectral laws among975621 magnitude laws satisfying square norm and necessary even/common-mod4 arithmetic.
